portrait_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Solo vertical waist-up character-card portrait of Itsuki Nakano, long red hair with upright ahoge, two yellow star-shaped hair clips, blue eyes, burgundy school vest over white collared shirt with green bow tie, from The Quintessential Quintuplets. Faithful recognizable anime design, refined crisp lineart and soft cel shading. Calm attentive expression with a slight character-appropriate smile. Age-appropriate nonsexual teenage student. Full head with generous headroom, centered composition, softly blurred sunlit school interior background. No text, watermark, panels, border or other characters.
Finales Profilbild: neutral-Variante mit erweitertem Bildausschnitt; siehe neutral-Prompt.
